title: PM-KISAN (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi)
benefit: Rs 6,000 per year per family, in three instalments of Rs 2,000

verification: VERIFIED 2026-10-09 against the official PM-KISAN FAQ (Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, published on pib.gov.in, dated 23 Nov 2021), Q6 eligibility (all landholding farmer families, revised w.e.f. 1 Jun 2019), Q7 exclusions, Q15 documents. Family = husband, wife and minor children. PARTIAL MODEL: not asked yet are exclusion (i) institutional landholders, (ii)(a)(b) constitutional posts, ministers, MPs/MLAs/MLCs, mayors, district panchayat chairpersons, and (f) registered practising professionals; the govt-job question does not separate the MTS / Class IV / Group D exception in (c)/(d).
